sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.14

Easier checkout for gift cards, clearer club messages.

  • Orders with nothing to ship, such as gift cards, now check out with just a billing address. No delivery choice, shipping address or carrier step.
  • "Join the club" links in club-only and locked product messages now show as working links instead of raw text.
  • Short descriptions on product cards show more text, and a new setting in the Styling Studio picks the length.
  • Google Pay is ready for checkout, with a new Express Pay section in the Styling Studio. It stays off until it is turned on for your winery.
